attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster animation sprite source for HARVEST THE NIGHT, a cozy farm that becomes a fortress against zombies at night.
Input images: Image 1 is the accepted farmer identity/shape master and pixel-art style reference, NOT an edit target. Preserve that exact straw hat, brown hatband, dark hair, cream shirt, blue bib overalls with brass strap buttons, brown work boots, skin and body proportions.
Style/medium: coherent pixel art with deliberate crisp pixel clusters, colored outlines, restrained texture, readable material planes, no blur or painterly smoothing.
Composition/framing: orthographic three-quarter top-down game view on a rectangular grid, same camera and body proportions as the accepted master. Final native frame canvas 48x48 pixels, visible upright body approximately 20x30 pixels, feet/contact pivot (24,44). These are downstream conversion targets; the generated source should retain simple coherent clusters that survive nearest reduction.
Lighting/mood: neutral warm daytime, highlights from upper left, darker underside. Runtime supplies dusk/night. No baked shadow, glow, ground or background.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent background across the complete image including gutters.
Constraints: complete unclipped character, no tools or held objects, stable body/hat dimensions, consistent clothing and face, no text, labels, cell borders, watermark or UI. No diamond-isometric perspective or random speckle.
Primary request: Generate the idle_south animation with exactly 3 sequential frames of this same accepted farmer.
Facing SOUTH toward the viewer. Three ordered idle frames: 0 neutral eyes open; 1 soft exhale with slight shoulder relaxation and half-closed eyes; 2 recovered posture with a gentle blink. Both boots remain planted at exactly the same baseline. Breathing moves chest/arms subtly, never scales the head or body. The last-to-first transition forms a calm loop.
Strip layout: ONE horizontal row containing exactly 3 equal-sized square frame cells, in the stated left-to-right order. Leave generous transparent gutter between complete figures and margins around the row. Every frame has the same scale, aligned horizontal center within its cell, same foot-contact baseline, and all character pixels entirely inside its own cell. No extra row, no large master character beside the strip, no skipped/duplicate gait phase. This is an animation strip, not a collage of different characters.
attempts.decision: accepted after native strip review; runtime gates recorded in reviews/0004
